premises.text: Manual chemical synthesis design is highly inefficient and error-prone and is the overlooked bottleneck in drug discovery
premises.evidence_span: Designing how to synthesize a given molecule is highly inefficient and prone to errors. It involves chemists manually digging through tens and hundreds of scientific publications. Chemical synthesis is the overlooked bottleneck in drug discovery

premises.text: AI designs novel chemical synthesis routes from commercially available molecules within seconds instead of hours or days
premises.evidence_span: Molecule One leverages artificial intelligence to design novel chemical synthesis within seconds instead of hours or days

premises.text: Found synthesis routes are ranked by user-preferred criteria and supported with lab-tested evidence
premises.evidence_span: found ways are ranked according to user-preferred criteria, presented to the user, and supported with lab-tested evidence

premises.text: Deep learning on prior experiments proposes viable novel steps assembled into multi-step pathways to the target
premises.evidence_span: The system is based on deep learning. It utilizes information about previous experiments to find out what kinds of transformations between different molecules are viable

premises.text: Competitor software does not use AI on chemical datasets for synthesis planning and often fails to generalize to novel molecules
premises.evidence_span: Software of our competitors does not utilize AI to leverage chemical datasets for synthesis planning and often has trouble generalizing to novel molecules

premises.text: Initial focus is the drug discovery ecosystem, with SaaS priced by seats or data points plus enterprise custom integrations and optional on-premise deployment
premises.evidence_span: Our initial focus is the drug discovery ecosystem, which craves for the utilization of recent advances in artificial intelligence
